note: The spaces the church rents to other churches and community groups. Space ids deliberately match the bookable facility ids in ministries.json so one double-booking check covers member reservations AND outside rentals. Rates are left blank on purpose — the app shows 'Ask about rates' until a rate string is filled in, and it NEVER processes payment (the office invoices; see data/giving.json for how money actually moves). CHANGE-ME: rewrite the intro, the descriptions, and the house rules in your church's own voice. Edit and push; see docs/MANAGE.md.
intro: Our building serves the whole community. Congregations without a home, choirs, neighborhood groups — our doors are open. Request the dates you need and the church office will confirm within a couple of days.

spaces.name: The Sanctuary
spaces.goodFor: Worship services, weddings, funerals, concerts, and choir rehearsals.
houseRules: Leave the space as you found it — the next group is counting on it.
Sound system and instruments by arrangement with the church office.
No food or drink in the sanctuary; the Fellowship Hall is made for that.

spaces.name: The Fellowship Hall
spaces.goodFor: Banquets, meetings, receptions, and community events — kitchen access by arrangement.
houseRules: Kitchen use must be arranged ahead of time with the church office.
Take your trash out and wipe the tables down before you lock up.
Music at a neighborly volume after 9 PM.

policy.approval: Every request is reviewed and confirmed by the church office — a request is not a booking until it is approved.
policy.payment: Rates and payment are handled directly with the office. The app never takes a payment.
policy.access: Approved guests receive a building-access pass for their booked time window — shown in this app under their booking code.
